select pd.id, pd.name, pd.product_line_id, pd.type, pd.`desc`, pd.status, pd.priority, pd.owner, pd.is_deleted, pd.create_man_id, pd.create_man, pd.create_date, pd.modify_man_id, pd.modify_man, pd.modify_date, pd.owner_id from product_demand pd left join product_biz_demand pbd on pd.id = pbd.product_demand_id where pbd.biz_demand_id = #{bizDemandId} and pbd.is_deleted = false

SELECT a.id,a.name,a.priority,a.owner,a.status,a.create_man,a.create_date,b.modify_date FROM product_demand a LEFT JOIN project_product_demand b ON a.id = b.product_demand_id AND b.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN project c ON b.project_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = false where c.id = #{projectId}
